rule: evidence levels are never mixed inside a single statement

levels.1: PROSPECTIVE PRIMARY EVIDENCE (STEP5H-B PRIMARY zero-shot only)
levels.2: PROSPECTIVE SECONDARY SENSITIVITY (STEP5H-B FULL11 SECONDARY only)
levels.3: POST-BLIND PREREGISTERED RECOVERY (STEP5I random few-shot, maximin, R0/R1/R2)
levels.4: POST-BLIND DESCRIPTIVE MECHANISM (NBNI3, topology, temperature, coverage)

LEVEL_1: STEP5H-B PRIMARY zero-shot mean TVD, CI, topology accuracy, per-family MAE, true and predicted topology distributions
CONTEXT_NOT_EVIDENCE: STEP5C / STEP5E / STEP5F retrospective LOEO (model-family context, not scores of the frozen production checkpoints)

conditional_phrase.phrase: one point / one composition is sufficient
conditional_phrase.allowed_only_with: an explicit statement that one composition is 11 CALPHAD temperature states
